slides.title: an arcade night
slides.detail: load up a game card, pick a rival game, loser buys the snacks.

slides.title: cook a new cuisine together
slides.detail: pick a dish neither of you has made. shop for it together first.

slides.title: go ice skating
slides.detail: fun to be bad at together. get hot chocolate right after.

slides.title: a museum late night
slides.detail: lots of museums stay open late once a month. go, then get dessert.
